verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general documentation for Query DSL, ES|QL and KQL, plus a link into the REST API reference. Nothing shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. A quickstart curl one-liner and static docs are adjacent features, not an interactive, runnable API explorer.
